title: September 2026 intake production - batch H7: five genuine new roots and five targeted improvements from the 22 and 23 September 2026 Kochi reports
note: FIRST SEPTEMBER BATCH. Authorised by the Founder's September 2026 Oral intake brief (session of 2026-09-23) as a bounded candidate, subject to Founder review before commit. Scope was set by the adjudication, not by the brief's topic list: of 153 occurrences only five asks were genuinely new (independently upheld), and the five enrichments are the limb gaps pressed by more than one candidate or panel AND closable from primary sources held on 2026-09-23. Every other limb gap and every confirmed live-card defect is carried, not dropped, in SEPTEMBER2026_PRODUCTION_QUEUE.json. Two repairs to shipped cards made in the same session are separate correction records (CORR-COGSA2025-20260923 on QB1_A#q27, CORR-SOLASXII-TITLES-20260923 on QB4_A#q20) and one is HELD (QB7_I#q3 X-DF stroke error - a structural rewrite, not a bounded edit). Counter normalisation: on QB5_E, QB1_C and QB7_D the header stat, section count and count label were set to the true card count while adding a card; provenance prose that records a page's original batch was left untouched. No examiner attribution was minted: every source occurrence is PANEL_LEVEL_ONLY or its attribution is not carried to a card.
examiner_relationship_delta_note: Zero by construction, as in H6: no new or enriched card carries a data-examiner attribute and no STRONG_CE_TIP_REVIEW decision row was added. SEP occurrences create no relationship rows; recurrence is recorded as matched_question_id in SEPTEMBER2026_INTAKE_ADJUDICATIONS.json. Six H7 source occurrences carry individual source attribution to one registered examiner (four explicit: SEP-0066, SEP-0067, SEP-0100, SEP-0102; two inferred from panel role: SEP-0090, SEP-0091; identity held in the private intake record (D-H7-3)); none is published by H7, and the index remains 958 relationships / 7 examiners.
